findings.description: Use of exec to load constant version from trusted file during installation, not user-controllable
findings.reasoning: The use of exec here is only loading a static version string from a local file under the developer/maintainer's control as part of packaging metadata. This does not process any user-supplied input and is standard practice in Python packaging. There is no risk of code injection unless an attacker has already compromised the source repository or file system, in which case the overall security is already lost. There is no user-controlled path to execution, nor is the file writable by untrusted parties. Thus, this is a false positive.

evidence.usage_context: During package setup, version is loaded by maintainer code.
